basic_info.description: This grand full-floor condominium is a rare offering in prime Pacific Heights, blending classic San Francisco architecture w/ generous scale, elegant details, & modern comforts. With five spacious bedrooms, two full bathrooms, formal double parlor living room, & multiple options for home offices or creative spaces, the flexible floor plan adapts beautifully to a variety of lifestyles w/easy potential for creating an ensuite primary bedroom. The heart of the home is a stylish kitchen w/ample space for a center island, flowing directly to an exclusive deck & a beautifully manicured garden/patio, perfect for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Kitchen is well appointed with a walk-in pantry. An adjacent family room with large dining area creates a warm, inviting space ideal for everyday moments & sophisticated entertaining alike. Other features include a large lndry room, exquisite period detailing, gorgeous refinished hardwood floors thruout & an unusually rare amenity in the city: two-car side-by-side garage parking + additional storage, a true luxury. Set in an unbeatable AAA location, just steps from the boutiques, cafes, and acclaimed restaurants of Fillmore Street, this is an exceptional opportunity to own a timeless home in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods.
